name: Pb-Sn
industry_note: 63Sn-37Pb solder (63 wt% Sn) is near-eutectic: it melts over a very narrow temperature range, close to the eutectic temperature.
_source: Assessed Pb-Sn description (Fecht et al. 1989) from the NIST solder database, Pb-Sn subsystem.

citations.text: Kattner, U.R. (2017), Phase Diagrams & Computational Thermodynamics - Solder Systems, NIST Standard Reference Database 139, National Institute of Standards and Technology, https://doi.org/10.18434/T4759N (Accessed 12 October 2026).
